name: Tachibana Sanami
source:
At one point in my life, I needed permission for everything. I couldn't even read my favorite books.

Those wounds on my heart gradually deepened, until I reached my limit. When the one person I'd allowed the tiniest space in my heart for betrayed me, all hope seemed lost.

However, a lot has changed since then, and now I feel truly glad to be alive.

[From the [url=https://sprite.net/everlastingflowers/character/sanami/en]official website[/url]]
